notes.title: Performance & foliage update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I got a Steamdeck on my birthday so I made some performance optimisation in the game that should affect everyone. Especially on volcano level, forest level and shadow level. The target was to reach a constant 60 FPS on the deck : it's a success !

Here's the changelog
- Optimisation in volcano level, forest level and void level (mostly concerning lighting ; render calls optimisation & level loading / unloading)
- More foliage in forest level (it's cheap now to render that, so I cracked it up a bit !)
- Special settings applied if you play on a deck (mostly concerning shadows : they are so greedy !)

I hope you'll enjoy, if you find bugs or problems you can reach out to me via discussions !
Have a good weekend !
Narom

notes.title: Release date announced & some news
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Thanks for all the wishlists and support for Pillars of Light, it means a lot.
I started working on Pillars of light 2 years ago and as a solo developer, releasing is the end of a rich journey. I hope my work will please you !

The launch will be on 29/09/22 at 5pm CET
The sell price will be 14.99€.
It will have a launch discount of 15% for a few days. That means you will be able to get it at 12.75€, youhou !

In the mean time I still have some work to do and some room for last minute improvements.

One of this task is translating the game to make it available to most.

The goal I have is to make the game available in english / french / german / spanish & italian. The store page in these languages should all be online soon. The game should be translated upon release in these languages.

I might be able to add some other languages but let's not be too greedy, they might come after release.
If you'd like to see the game in your language, feel free to ask :)

Have a great day
See you soon
Narom42
